text.p: Grain and oilseed exports reported by USDA and private export sources.

WHEAT SALE - Egypt's government-owned Holding Company for Rice and Flour Mills said on Monday it bought 165,000 tonnes of American hard red winter wheat or Australian hard red wheat for delivery in June and July.
SOYBEAN SALE - Exporters reported the sale of 150,000 tonnes of U.S. soybeans to unknown destinations for 1997/98 delivery.

CORN TENDERS - Naseem Agriculture of Abu Dhabi is seeking a consignment of 10,000 or 15,000 tonnes of U.S., Argentine or South African yellow maize for shipment in the second half of August, South Africa's shippers association said. Bids were invited C and F Abu Dhabi by June 6.
- South Korea's Korea Feed Association (KFA) passed on a tender to buy 52,500 tonnes of corn due to high offer prices, traders said on Tuesday.
- CCC said it will offer 8.2 million bushels of corn for sale from its feedgrain catalog, with offers due June 3 and results announced June 4.

WHEAT TENDERS - Iraq was still negotiating the purchase of 50,000 tonnes of U.S. hard red winter wheat for July shipment under a United Nations monitored oil-for-food pact, European grain traders said. The tender launched since last week has not yet led to any sales because exporters feel Iraq's bid of $194 per tonne, including cost and freight, is too low, they said. Exporters have placed initial offers to sell the wheat at around $210-212 per tonne.
- Pakistan seeks 376,000 tonnes of U.S. and/or Australian white wheat on May 28, according to a Pakistan embassy official. Shipment is for June 11-July 10.
WHEAT TENDERS (Cont) - Sri Lanka seeks 50,000 to 60,000 tonnes of PL-480 wheat for June 30-July 19 shipment. Offers are due by 1930 GMT June 5 at the Sri Lankan embassy in Washington.
- CCC seeks 5,000 tonnes of U.S. HRW wheat on May 28 for donation to Benin. Shipment dates are June 15-July 10.

RICE TENDERS - Jordan postponed a tender to buy 15,000 tonnes of optional origin medium grain camolino rice until next week, U.S. rice exporters said. One exporter said the tender was for May 27 while another said it was for May 28. Delivery was for June with U.S. origin likely preferred.
RICE TENDER (Cont) - State-run Rice Export Corporation of Pakistan invited bids by May 26 for the export of 5,000 tonnes of basmati Pak-7 rice containing seven percent brokens.
- Syria's General Foreign Trade Organisation for Chemicals and Foodstuffs seeks offers June 4 to buy 12,000 tonnes of white rice for July with confirmation on June 12.
MARKET TALK - Thai animal feedproducers went on a corn buying spree this week to use up the 200,000 tonnes of imports allowed under a zero-tariff quota, trade sources said.

MARKET TALK (cont.) - Grain dealers in Asia on Tuesday could not confirm recent rumors of sales of up to 1.5 million tonnes of wheat to China, possibly destined partly for North Korea, by U.S. trader Cargill Inc. "Nobody can substantiate this, it's highly unlikely and knowning the Chinese, it just doesn't add up," said one wheat trader. Rumours that Cargill sold between 1.0-1.5 million tonnes of optional origin wheat to China or North Korea snaked through U.S. grains markets on Friday ... Malaysian corn importers were growing increasingly anxious on Tuesday, as buyers sat tight in a market overfilled with maize, trade sources said.
